name:        Collapsible
domain:      component
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Collapsible
description: Collapsible hides and reveals content behind a trigger button. Use it in settings panels, FAQ pages, or detail views to keep the page scannable while letting users drill into sections they care about. Wrap multiple collapsibles in CollapsibleGroup for accordion behavior. For custom collapsible components, use the `useCollapsible` hook directly (`astryx hook useCollapsible`).
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component Collapsible

name:        useCollapsible
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Collapsible
description: Reusable hook that encapsulates the collapsible state machine. Supports three modes: group-controlled (inside CollapsibleGroup), controlled (isOpen + onOpenChange), and uncontrolled (self-managed with defaultIsOpen). Used internally by Card and Section.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useCollapsible

name:        CollapsibleControlledAccordion
domain:      template
package:     @astryxdesign/core
displayName: Collapsible - Controlled
kind:        block
description: Manage the open section from parent state, so something other than a click can move it: a URL parameter, a form jumping to the step that failed validation, or the Previous/Next controls shown here. onChange hands back the whole open value.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template CollapsibleControlledAccordion --type block

name:        CollapsibleDividedAccordion
domain:      template
package:     @astryxdesign/core
displayName: Collapsible - FAQ
kind:        block
description: FAQ built with hasDividers: row hairlines and density padding with no custom CSS. Questions set their own type - body at semibold, not the trigger's default 17px large - so a list of questions reads as rows rather than a stack of headings, and question and answer separate on weight and color instead of size.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template CollapsibleDividedAccordion --type block

name:        CollapsibleGroupAccordion
domain:      template
package:     @astryxdesign/core
displayName: CollapsibleGroup - Density
kind:        block
description: density sets the block padding on every row in the group, so a list of sections can be tuned to the surface it sits on without touching the rows. compact for dense surfaces like sidebars and inspectors, balanced (the default) for page content, spacious for a short list that is the main thing on the page. It follows Table's scale and pairs with hasDividers, which turns it on at balanced.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template CollapsibleGroupAccordion --type block

name:        CollapsibleGroupShowcase
domain:      template
package:     @astryxdesign/core
displayName: CollapsibleGroup
kind:        block
description: CollapsibleGroup coordinates its Collapsible children: with type="single", opening one closes the others. No state or handlers in the example - the group owns which value is open and each child only declares its own. One Collapsible per Card, so each trigger keeps its default large type as the heading of its own surface.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template CollapsibleGroupShowcase --type block
